from solution import find_last_occurrence


def test_issue_example_5_returns_3():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: example with 5 returns 3."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    expected = 3  # 1+2 = 3
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 5) == expected


def test_issue_first_element_2_returns_0():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: single leading 2 returns 0."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    expected = 0  # 1-1 = 0
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 2) == expected


def test_issue_last_run_9_returns_9():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: trailing run of 9 returns 9."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    expected = 9  # 10-1 = 9
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 9) == expected


def test_issue_unique_middle_8_returns_6():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: single middle 8 returns 6."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    expected = 6  # 5+1 = 6
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 8) == expected


def test_issue_repeated_pair_6_returns_5():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: pair of 6s returns 5."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    expected = 5  # 4+1 = 5
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 6) == expected


def test_issue_single_element_returns_0():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: one-element array returns 0."""
    a = [42]
    expected = 0  # 1-1 = 0
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 42) == expected


def test_issue_all_equal_returns_last():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: all equal returns last index."""
    a = [7, 7, 7, 7]
    expected = 3  # 4-1 = 3
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 7) == expected


def test_issue_first_pair_returns_1():
    """Find index of last occurrence in sorted array: leading pair returns 1."""
    a = [1, 1, 2, 3]
    expected = 1  # 0+1 = 1
    assert find_last_occurrence(a, 1) == expected


def test_contract_value_at_index_equals_target():
    """Contract: returned index of last occurrence must hold the requested value."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    result = find_last_occurrence(a, 6)
    assert a[result] == 6  # 5+1 = 6


def test_contract_next_after_last_differs():
    """Contract: index after last occurrence in sorted array holds a different value."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    result = find_last_occurrence(a, 5)
    assert a[result + 1] == 6  # 5+1 = 6


def test_contract_return_is_int():
    """Contract: find index of last occurrence in sorted array returns an int index."""
    a = [2, 5, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 9, 9, 9]
    result = find_last_occurrence(a, 5)
    assert isinstance(result, int)
